title: Covariant Hamilton-Jacobi Formulation of Electrodynamics via the Polysymplectic Reduction and Its Relation to the Canonical Hamilton-Jacobi Theory
content: The covariant Hamilton-Jacobi formulation of Electrodynamics is systematically derived from the first-order (Palatini-like) Lagrangian. This derivation utilizes the De Donder–Weyl covariant Hamiltonian formalism with constraints incroporating generalized Direc brackets of forms and the associated polysymplectic reduction, which ensure the manifest covariance and consistency with the field dynamics. It is also demonstrated that the canonical Hamilton-Jacobi equation in variational derivatives and the Gauss law constraint are derived from the covariant De Donder-Weyl Hamilton-Jacobi formulation after the space+time decomposition.
